title: I was lonely and working 15-hour days in the US. Moving to the Philippines gave me a community.
description: Britt McAlister said he tried pickleball and church, but found it hard to form genuine friendships in the US.
content:
Britt McAllister said he struggled to find close friendships in the US. After moving to the Philippines, he found the sense of community he'd been missing.Provided by Britt McAlister.
